what: Arena uploads of this project, one entry per CG agent; tools/arena_compare.py reads and checks it (policy P1, docs/arena-uploads.md). A label holds one configuration (artifact.config, cr.submit.Build.config: the artifact text before the runner section plus PARAMS). An upload whose placement ended in a promotion gets promotedTo and no placement score. Scores compare within one league only. noiseMargins: a league whose P1 verdicts use another league's noise margin M by the user's decision (from: the source league, M: its value at the decision, which arena_compare.py requires it to still have).

silver.why: v08's two Silver placements (20.70, 20.74) give Silver's own M 0.06 on 1 df, which would roll back any candidate not better; the user chose Bronze's M (2.46, 11 df) until they decide otherwise. Silver's own M is printed as context.
